author: Mnimiy
verification: Fetched from X via twitter-cli from global-search; original author and post URL preserved.
note: Original post did not expose a complete repeatable prompt. Treat this as a real showcase post, not a verified tutorial.
originalText:
Claude Fable 5 just beat Pokemon FireRed reading nothing but the raw screen.

no map, no game-state feed, no helper tools, about 50 minutes start to finish.

older Claude models couldn't clear it even with a full helper harness.

the point isn't the game. it's that Fable reads a screen the way it reads text.

screenshot -> working code. scientific figure -> exact numbers. UI -> spec.

if your work has ever been "look at this and rebuild it," that just became the cheap part.

the article maps where vision actually pays and where it's overkill.
